mentions.name: Flex
mentions.description: Flex is an AI-powered tool that lets non-technical users make changes to their existing product without needing a developer, described as "Lovable for your existing product." It is also evolving toward being an internal cloud for hosting dashboards that non-technical people build with Claude, helping them get those tools into production.
mentions.problem: Non-technical people in product, ops, sales, account management, and customer success need a developer to make changes to their existing product, and apps thrown together with Claude have no clear way to get into production.
mentions.audience: Product, Ops, Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success professionals who want to change their existing product without a developer or get Claude-built tools into production.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Flex (https://flexenv.com/)

I am speaking to initial customers and from my initial pain at my day job it was going to be a way to be "Lovable for your existing product" . But it also seems like it might turn into "internal cloud to host dashboards non-technical people are making with Claude".
mentions.author: aliclark
